title: senecio johnstonii subsp. cheranganiensis
intro: Senecio johnstonii subsp. cheranganiensis, commonly known as Cherangani Senecio or Mountain Everlasting, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is native to the high-altitude regions of East Africa and is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects that can be used to treat various health conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce inflammation and fight infections. The health benefits of Senecio johnstonii subsp. cheranganiensis include its potential to treat skin conditions, such as acne and eczema, and its ability to act as an antioxidant, which can help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being.
